ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 1:12 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (localized markings) to low-intensity charcoal-black pixels (primary surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity base with scattered, high-contrast white circular rings (annular scars) on the mid-left and central regions; two distinct diagonal high-intensity linear streaks on the right distal lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth reaching approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular sawtooth serrations with 3-8 pixel amplitudes, continuous from the medial notch to the distal tips, most prominent on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered distal tips that sweep dorsally/upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least 12 distinct high-contrast white annular rings (scars) primarily clustered on the left medial lobe and the lower central peduncle junction.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three parallel diagonal linear tracks on the upper right lobe and multiple fragmented horizontal/oblique scratches on the lower left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcareous barnacle clusters (Coronula diadema) present on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes; minor irregular tissue irregularities (indentations) on the right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined central longitudinal ridge (peduncle keel) extending from the water line into the fluke junction.
